Kathleen Gramzay, BCTMB, is the CEO and Founder of Kinessage LLC.  She is a Speaker, Author, National Continuing Education Provider and Developer of the Kinessage® Release Your Pain Self Care System. She is a 19-year board-certified massage therapist, soft tissue & movement specialist serving wellness conscious individuals, organizations & their employees to live more joyful, productive lives.

This YouTube channel consists of useful tips, and how to videos to help people accomplish just that.  Some videos include tips for better back sleeping; self care tips for heavy lifting, techniques to clear your mind, and so much more. This channel is perfect for people looking for practical information to increase wellness across the board of their life. 

For more assistance and information about Kathleen Gramzay, please visit her website- https://kathleengramzay.com/speaking/
